title: SemPSG: A Semantic Channel-Aware Foundation Model for Polysomnography Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.36619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Polysomnography (PSG) integrates multiple physiological signals to provide a comprehensive characterization of human sleep, yet its heterogeneous channel configurations across centers pose substantial challenges for transferable representation learning. Existing foundation models mainly focus on physiological modeling or temporal learning, while channel identity is often treated as a fixed structural index, overlooking the physiological semantics encoded by signal modality and reference configuration. To this end, we propose SemPSG, a Semantic channel-aware foundation model for heterogeneous PSG analysis. SemPSG explicitly represents the physiological semantics of channel identity and incorporates them into both signal representation learning and channel aggregation, enabling flexible modeling across diverse data configurations. translated_title: SemPSG：一种面向多导睡眠图分析的语义通道感知基础模型
translated_abstract: 多导睡眠图（PSG）整合多种生理信号，为人类睡眠提供全面的表征，然而其在不同中心间异构的通道配置为可迁移的表示学习带来了重大挑战。现有的基础模型主要聚焦于生理建模或时序学习，而通道身份通常被视为固定的结构索引，忽略了信号模态和参考配置所编码的生理语义。为此，我们提出了SemPSG，一种面向异构PSG分析的语义通道感知基础模型。SemPSG显式地表示通道身份的生理语义，并将其融入信号表示学习和通道聚合之中，从而能够在多样化的数据配置下实现灵活建模。具体而言，语义条件化的时间序列编码器能够捕获信号特定的时序动态和跨……（原文摘要不完整）
tldr: 提出SemPSG基础模型，通过显式建模通道身份的生理语义并将其融入信号表示学习与通道聚合，实现对不同中心异构通道配置PSG数据的灵活迁移分析。
en_tdlr: SemPSG is a semantic channel-aware foundation model that explicitly encodes the physiological semantics of channel identity into signal representation learning and channel aggregation, enabling flexible analysis of heterogeneous PSG configurations across centers.
